title: Good Substrings
statement: For every index of a digit string of length n up to 3·10^5, the task counts the good substrings covering it, where a substring is bad if it contains 2025 but not 2026 as a subsequence. Bad ones are subtracted from i(n−i+1): per left end, greedy next-occurrence matching makes the bad right ends one interval, so each left end adds a constant-then-linear range update through a second-order difference array.
